projects.name: FixAsset API
projects.description: Robust Backend API for a comprehensive Fixed Asset Management System. Engineered to seamlessly handle asset tracking, inventory management, master data, and complex approval workflows.
highlights: Engineered core modules for comprehensive Asset, Inventory, and Approval management.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization utilizing Azure AD and JWT.
Designed and deployed automated scheduled tasks (CRON) for workflow notifications.
Integrated AWS S3 for highly available and scalable document and image storage.
Developed advanced features including dynamic Excel report generation and QR code integration.

projects.name: Roof API (tixget.com)
projects.description: Scalable Backend API powering the Roof/Tixget ticketing and booking platform, engineered to handle complex business logic and third-party integrations.
highlights: Spearheaded API development, maintenance, and optimization for high-performance platform operations.
Engineered dynamic PDF generation pipelines utilizing TCPDF and DOMPDF for ticketing and invoicing.
Implemented advanced spreadsheet processing and data extraction using PhpSpreadsheet.
Seamlessly integrated QR Code functionality for efficient ticket validation and user flows.
